limitations: Profiling plus extra leaf gates has measured overhead: compare B-ref to B-binary separately.
Authority independently recomputes at seal, but client/server still share that plan; no independent provider replan RPC.
All primary maximum probes fit; lower-cap fallback is tested separately.
No real storage/readCommitted, five-process throughput, eight-read success or production adoption.
Raw measurements are stored with two-space indentation (52,897,160 B, above the 50 MiB push recommendation); later experiments store raw without indentation.

reviewCorrections.probeUniqueness: Require unique commandDigest per planner invocation, including both search and final probes; independent seal invocation may repeat the same candidates.

reviewCorrections2.exactOriginalPlan: Compare the whole plan value (planDigest, commands, wireBytes, workUnits, sourceBytes) with the original I0 planner for both strategies, and pin each invocation final re-check by count, order and commandDigest.
reviewCorrections2.nonWireFailure: A non-wire failure injected once at wire:before or wire:after fails the plan at its first probe; it is never converted into a smaller range.
